fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects chmod targeting files in abnormal directory paths.
fields.name: Chmod Suspicious Directory
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "/chmod" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "/tmp/" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/.Library/" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/etc/" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/opt/")))
